project_type: FairWatt Home build kit: a hackathon workflow repo. The app (Next.js static export) is built on event day; this task is a Python backend-only calculation module producing committed static JSON artifacts a separate frontend reads from the GitHub repo.
language: Python 3.13.5 (repo interpreter). TypeScript/React exist for the app but are OUT OF SCOPE for this task.
build_system: No Python build system; scripts are run directly with python3. numpy 2.2.5, pandas 2.3.3, pytest 9.0.3, openpyxl 3.1.5 are already installed. Do NOT add dependencies (agent-rule #8). The JS app uses npm/Next.js 16.4.2 but that is not touched here.
test_framework: pytest 9.0.3. No pytest config file exists; pytest auto-discovers tests/backend/test_*.py. Run from repo root.
build_command: python3 src/backend/build_stats.py && python3 src/backend/build_savings.py && python3 src/backend/build_map.py  (regenerates the three data/build/*.json artifacts)
verification_instructions: After implementing a feature: (1) run its build entrypoint to (re)write its JSON artifact into data/build/ and confirm it prints a summary with no error; (2) run `python3 -m pytest tests/backend -q` and confirm the feature's tests pass; (3) confirm the untouched data snapshot still verifies: `python3 reference/verify_usage.py data/snapshot/recs_ma_2020.csv data/snapshot/eia_ma_monthly_2026-08.csv` prints 'G-DATA-3: PASS'. Grep is NOT verification.
snapshot_or_generated_files: The three committed artifacts data/build/consumption_stats.json, data/build/savings_model.json, data/build/map_consumption.json are generated by the build entrypoints and SHOULD be committed (the frontend reads them from the repo). Regenerate them with the build_command. data/build/ does not yet exist and must be created. Note .gitignore ignores data/raw/ and *.preview.svg but NOT data/build/*.json, so the artifacts commit normally.
environment_constraints: guard-git PreToolUse hook blocks cross-agent git ops: NEVER use `git add -A`, `git checkout`, `git switch`, `git stash`, `git reset`, or rebase (all agents share one working tree). Stage only this task's own new files BY NAME. Two sibling workflows run in parallel in the SAME tree: one owns the HMM regime model (reference/hmm_* or src/backend/hmm*), the other owns Monte Carlo + all-cities forecast (forecast_mc_*, allcities_*). Stay strictly within stats/savings/map filenames. Sandbox cannot reach the network, so data/build/towns.json may not exist (build_geo.mjs needs a download); the map feature must not hard-depend on it.
contribution_requirements: agent-rules.md (always-on steering): #1 NO invented numbers — every constant traces to ground-truth.md or code run on data/snapshot/; #3 fail closed on bad input; #8 no new deps/no runtime network calls; #11 any kWh not typed by a user is 'estimated for a home like yours', dollars are the 'supply portion' only. Keep every public function pure and importable so an API could wrap it later. structure.md declares reference/** frozen and orchestrator-owned — do NOT edit reference/*; put new code under src/backend/ instead.
key_patterns: Reuse parsing/derivation logic from the tested reference scripts, do NOT rediscover it: reference/verify_usage.py has the weighted-median (`wmed`) and the exact seasonal-share recomputation (per-year sales shares, mean over calendar years 2019-2025) and calendar-2025 kWh-per-account method; reference/ingest_rates.py `derive_terms` has the basic-service term-span rule (term start = previous term end + 1 month; fixed rate value sits on the term's LAST month; blank = no term ending that month). Column->UtilityId: NG->NG, NSTAR->EV_EAST, WMECo->EV_WEST, Unitil->UNITIL. Calculator formula (docs/specs/calculator.md): dollars = cents * kWh / 100, supply only; display half-up to cents matching regex ^-?\$\d{1,3}(,\d{3})*\.\d{2}$, internal math unrounded.
relevant_files: data/snapshot/recs_ma_2020.csv (552 MA homes: KWH, TOTSQFT_EN, YEARMADERANGE, FUELHEAT, TYPEHUQ, NWEIGHT ...)
data/snapshot/eia_ma_monthly_2026-08.csv (200 months EIA-861M: year, month, status, sales_mwh, customers, kwh_per_customer ...)
data/snapshot/fixed_residential_cents_2026-07-02.csv (22-yr basic-service fixed rates; term_end_year, term_end_month, NG, NSTAR, WMECo, Unitil)
reference/verify_usage.py (STUDY: wmed, seasonal shares, calendar-2025 kwh/account, ground-truth asserts)
reference/ingest_rates.py (STUDY: derive_terms term-span rule, num() cell parsing)
.kiro/steering/ground-truth.md (the ONLY numbers allowed without computing: seasonal shares, R2 0.34, estimator coeffs, rates, medians, typical account 7135)
docs/specs/calculator.md (supply-only dollar math, golden vectors G1-G4, display rounding)
docs/specs/estimator.md (RECS fit, bands, seasonal shape usage)
docs/specs/map.md (map spec; 'never color by a number we don't have' — drives the modeled-town honesty flag)
data/build/.plan/backend-stats-plan.md (the full implementation plan this task follows)
directory_structure: src/backend/ (NEW, this task's Python package: data_sources.py, stats_consumption.py, savings_model.py, map_consumption.py, build_stats.py, build_savings.py, build_map.py). tests/backend/ (NEW, pytest). data/build/ (NEW dir for committed artifacts). data/snapshot/ (verified read-only inputs). reference/ (frozen tested scripts to STUDY, not edit). research/backend-stats.md (NEW frontend contract doc; if G-OWN flags it, relocate to docs/research/).
